usage: vibe wikify adopt [-h] [--map MAP_FILE] [--include GLOB]
                         [--exclude GLOB] [--apply] [--report]
                         [--rewrite-refs] [--prune-sources] [--force]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --map MAP_FILE   Mapping file (default: docs/wiki/.wikifymap)
  --include GLOB   Only consider matching docs
  --exclude GLOB   Ignore matching docs
  --apply          Move the docs (default: dry run)
  --report         Print the plan as JSON
  --rewrite-refs   Rewrite relative links in moved and docs-only files
  --prune-sources  Also remove unrelated stale generated pages
  --force          Allow a dirty tree or detached HEAD
